Registering an Artifact Card is an explicit promotion. It links back to its producing run;

RUNS WITH FILES BUT NO REGISTERED ARTIFACTS
run_09 recorded 7 files and registered no Artifact Cards — its files remain files; they are never presented as artifacts.
